rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5 and 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008, -p1-011): the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it; the prototype draws the amend review's refused Continue deliberately as a silent hold (its trace and its own spec both assert no error summary), DR1 made no judgement on the amend review, and the hold itself is the validation constraint, which the prototype expresses, so the prototype's amend-review behaviour wins and the draft review's error summary stays a draft-review behaviour.
outcome: Continue on the amend review is held while any answer is invalid or incomplete (such as an arrival date outside 7 days back to 6 months ahead): the trader stays on the amend review, and, as Design Release 2.1 draws and specifies it, no error summary or error message is shown. The draft review's error summary with a Complete <card> link per incomplete section is not carried over to the amend review: the prototype wins by default, DR1 judged nothing about the amend review, and the only real constraint (an amendment is resubmitted only once complete and valid) is met by the hold itself.
